children: Enovis entered a binding offer to acquire eCential Robotics for an enterprise value of approximately €155,000,000 with up-front cash consideration of ~€176,000,000 and up to €35,000,000 contingent on milestones.
Binding offer to acquire eCential Robotics, a surgical robotics developer, at ~€155M enterprise value.
Up-front cash consideration of approximately €176M payable at closing; up to €35M contingent on milestone achievement.
Transaction expected to close by year-end 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and works council consultation in France.
Enovis expects ~150 bps deal-related dilution to adjusted EBITDA margin in 2027, netting to ~100 bps headwind after improvements.
Enovis plans to fund the deal with cash and availability under its existing revolving credit facility.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Enovis agrees to acquire eCential Robotics for ~€155M enterprise value, up to €35M earnout
